notes.title: Idle Craft Speedrun Challenge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464255/d9a7266877e8c1865a2eecabb55e14f882ac0605.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Event Dates:[/b] February 28th – March 3rd, during the Next Fest.[/h3]

[h3][b]🎮 How to Participate[/b][/h3]
[b]1️⃣ Enable the Challenge Timer:[/b]
   - Go to the Settings menu in *Idle Craft Demo*.
   - Toggle on the Challenge Timer option.
[b]2️⃣ Reset Your Progress:[/b]
   - In the Settings, click on Reset Progress to start fresh.
   - Note: This will clear your current game progress, so make sure you're ready to begin the challenge!
[b]3️⃣ Race to Level 10:[/b]
   - Start playing and reach Level 10 as fast as you can!
   - Aim to do it in under 5 minutes to unlock the "God of Speedrunners" achievement.
[b]4️⃣ Capture Your Result:[/b]
   - Take a screenshot showing Demo Finale screen, with your time! ()
[b]5️⃣ Submit Your Screenshot to join a Leaderboard:[/b]
   - Join our [url=https://discord.gg/8fsjTNjQRF]Discord server[/url] and post your screenshot in the #speedrun channel.

[h3][b]🏆 Prizes[/b][/h3]
👉🏻 Every player who got the achievement "God of Speedrunners", by finishing the challenge in less than 5 minutes - will get a game key of your choice from our JoyBits portfolio! 
👉🏻 All the entries will be added to a Leaderboard! 10 Best times from the final Leaderboard will also get a game key of your choice from our JoyBits portfolio! 

[url=https://discord.gg/8fsjTNjQRF]Lets gooooo![/url]

notes.title: Idle Craft Demo Update 3
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Demo has been updated today.
What's new? 

- [b]14 Achievements[/b] were added to the game. Some of them are hidden and you need to figure out how to get them! 
- [b]Speedrunner Mode.[/b] If you are interested in trying to speedrun the demo - this one is for you! Just turn the Speedrunner mode in settings, reset the progress and you are ready to go with a brand-new timer integrated to the game! 
[i]P.S. There are two achievements for Speedrunners, we are curious if any of you will be able to get to level 10 in 5 minutes![/i]
- Even more elements are available in the game!
- Interface and tutorial optimizations.
- Minor bug and gameplay fixes.

Glad to see sooo many players already tried our game and even left reviews! 
We are happy and motivated to continue improving and working on the Full game!

Stay tuned for more updates and info,
Cheers

notes.title: Idle Craft Demo Update 2
notes.content:
Demo has been updated today.
This update is rather small and more focused on game performance stability, as well as bugs fixing!

Also, we have added even more elements to the game ;)

Update your demo now and don't forget to leave your feedback, we are working day and night to make the game better based on your feedback!

notes.title: Idle Craft Demo Update – Live Now!
notes.content:
[b]We're excited to announce our latest demo update. Check out what’s new:[/b]

• The game now runs with fewer hiccups and improved performance.
• Element prices in the store have been revised.
• Fixed bugs during game startup.
• More Levels – Enjoy going over Level 10!
• Hotkey functionality has been enhanced for a more streamlined play.
• Boosted Offline Bonuses – We've upped the offline bonus count.
• New Elements Added!
• Faster Chest Drops – The speed of auto-dropped chests has been increased for quicker rewards.

Update your demo now and don't forget to leave your feedback, we are working day and night to make the game better based on your feedback!
